key_functionalities: 15 full-screen slides with keyboard (ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Space, PageUp, PageDown) & touch/click navigation
Slide progress bar indicator at top/bottom and slide counter pill ('Slide 04 / 15')
Interactive Slide Overview Drawer / Grid selector modal to jump directly to any slide
Interactive Use-of-Capital allocation breakdown chart (Recharts pie/bar) with hover details
Interactive Ecosystem Module selector with animated tab details
Interactive Financial Scenario Toggle (Conservative vs Base vs Optimistic)
Download PDF / Print-Friendly View mode (renders entire 15-slide deck linearly for standard browser printing or PDF saving)
Investor Interest / Inquiry dialog form with toast confirmation
Presenter view notes toggle (optional investor presentation mode)
instructions_to_main_agent: Construct all 15 slides with rich, realistic content for SYMSTRUO—no generic placeholder text like 'Lorem ipsum' or 'TBD'.
Use Framer Motion for crisp, low-latency slide entry transitions (`AnimatePresence` with direction-aware sliding and fading).
Ensure the PDF / Print-Friendly mode formats all 15 slides into distinct page-break sections (`@media print` rules) so printing or saving as PDF works cleanly without visual overflow.

Verify all interactive buttons, navigation triggers, slide thumbnails, and form inputs include explicit `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid='next-slide-button'`, `data-testid='slide-thumb-5'`, `data-testid='export-pdf-button'`).
Maintain strict dark theme contrast compliance with WCAG AA standards using bright white headings (`#F8FAFC`), muted slate subtexts (`#94A3B8`), and gold highlights (`#D4AF37`).
Never use generic centered layouts across all slides—vary the layout structure (Split Bento grids, Left heavy headlines, 3-column feature cards, full-width timeline steps, matrix comparison table).
